release.qa_note:
2026-08-22 — THE FULL REGRESSION PASS WAS NOT OBTAINED. Stated plainly rather than dressed up.
  What IS proven:
    · backend tests/contracts.test.js 21/21 serial, run while the test DB was healthy. Covers the ONLY endpoint changed, and includes two new checks asserting the payload carries agreed_mode and that a contract with no agreement still returns.
    · backend tests/contract* 19/19 serial, same healthy window.
    · mobile suite 159/159 (144 before; the 15 new are the working-style mapping checks).
    · android bundle builds clean — the check that matters for these screens, since no test imports them.
  What is NOT proven: zero regression across the whole backend suite.
  Why: the local test database became unresponsive mid-verification. Two runs of IDENTICAL code returned 100 and then 126 failures against a 93 baseline — non-determinism, so neither number measures anything. Cause classified from the output: 120 "Connection terminated" plus 17 connect timeouts = 137 of the failures are the DB dropping connections, not code. Only 2 were real and both are pre-existing missing-module errors (collection-library, quotaCheck). The container then stopped accepting connections entirely and docker restart hung.
  NOT CLAIMED GREEN. NOT CLAIMED NO-REGRESSION. This release is backed by targeted evidence plus a post-deploy check against production, and the full serial pass is OWED once the test database is back.
owed: Full serial backend suite once the local test DB is healthy, measured like-for-like against the 93-failure baseline.
